text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe tells me that her body is weak. Her words ring true, as a number of strange ailments begin to afflict her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her body weight fluctuates rapidly in a short period of time. On top of that, her toenails begin to crack, interfering with her ability to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With these bizarre issues affecting her body one after another, all I can offer her right now is patience and support. Gathering every last bit of my knowledge and expertise, I look for a solution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, these strange happenings can't be chalked up to her weak constitution… These afflictions seem almost… supernatural.
